C1247.title: Chinese-American Men Arrested in California for Tampering with Gift Cards to Steal Funds
C1247.summary: In August 2025, police in Santa Rosa, California, arrested two Chinese-American men suspected of orchestrating a large-scale gift card fraud. The suspects opened gift card packaging on retail shelves, recorded card numbers and PINs or directly altered the security codes, then resealed and returned the cards to store displays.
